## Preston Peten — Briefing

**Bottom line:** A real, attributable match exists and it points to one person: a Microsoft cloud specialist based in Frisco, TX (DFW). The name is rare, so confidence in the identity is high. The only same-name noise online is "PrestonPlayz" (Preston Arsement, a Minecraft YouTuber) and the town of Preston, Lancashire. Neither is related.

**Note on sourcing:** All substantive detail comes from data-aggregator profiles surfaced through Brave Search snippets. I could not open the LinkedIn profile or ZoomInfo page directly (LinkedIn login wall, ZoomInfo/Cloudflare blocks), so role specifics are "as listed" and may be slightly stale. There is no independent journalism, no talks, no interviews, and no news coverage on this person.

### Who he is

- **Current role:** Cloud Transformation Azure Specialist at Microsoft. His LinkedIn headline reads simply "Azure at Microsoft." RocketReach still lists an older title of "Microsoft Account Executive," so the AE-to-specialist transition is recent-ish.
- **Prior Microsoft role:** Account Executive driving growth with business customers across Modern Workplace, Business Applications, Apps & Infrastructure, and Data & AI. Served as advisor to CIOs and line-of-business executives, built technology roadmaps, managed renewals.
- **Before Microsoft:** Network and System Administrator with DRS Technologies, deployed in Iraq and Afghanistan. Earlier, Network Administrator with ITTSystems LLC in Iraq, running classified and unclassified network operations and maintenance.
- **Education:** MBA, Indiana University Kelley School of Business. Bachelor's, Purdue University College of Engineering.
- **Location:** Frisco, TX (DFW metroplex), per public records. Also traced to Brookhaven, GA and Merrillville, IN (consistent with Midwest roots and an Indiana/Chicago-area phone number).

### Profile links

- LinkedIn: linkedin.com/in/prestonpeten
- X/Twitter: @PrestonPeten (dormant, created 2014, roughly 10 followers, no posts). Skip it.
- Email follows the standard pattern: p***@microsoft.com

### Disambiguation notes

The four independent sources (LinkedIn, ZoomInfo, RocketReach, Intelius) all agree on Microsoft + DFW + the same career history, so this is one coherent person, not a name collision. Treat the title as current but not gospel; the AE versus Azure Specialist discrepancy across sources suggests a recent change.

### Golf small-talk talking points

- **The military/defense story is the standout.** Years running networks in Iraq and Afghanistan for DRS and ITTSystems. That is a memorable, humanizing opener and unusual in a Microsoft cloud crowd.
- **Midwest roots.** Purdue engineering undergrad plus a Kelley MBA, with Indiana/Merrillville and Chicago-area traces. Boilermakers fandom is a safe, friendly hook.
- **The arc itself is a good conversation.** Network admin in a war zone, then client-facing AE advising CIOs, now deep in Azure cloud transformation. He has a genuine "operator turned trusted advisor" story, useful if you want to talk cloud, modernization, or how enterprises actually adopt AI.
- **Local:** He is a Frisco neighbor. The DFW golf boom (PGA Frisco / Fields Ranch, plus the broader North Texas course scene) is an easy, relevant local topic.

**What I could not find:** No hobbies, no golf-specific info, no charity or team affiliations, and no public writing or speaking. So anything beyond the above for small talk will have to come from him.
